name: 1H EUR_USD
summary: This is a trend-following Expert Advisor designed for the 1-hour timeframe on EUR/USD. It identifies trend direction using moving average crossovers or momentum indicators and enters trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. The EA includes basic risk management with stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 这是一个针对EUR/USD一小时图表设计的趋势跟踪EA。它利用移动平均线交叉或动量指标判断趋势方向，并沿趋势方向开仓。该EA包含基本的止损止盈风险管理功能。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是趋势跟踪，通过技术指标识别市场主要趋势方向并在趋势延续时入场。入场条件通常基于快速均线与慢速均线的交叉，或价格突破均线来判断趋势启动。出场条件包括固定的止损止盈设置，以及可能的趋势反转信号平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位方法。资金管理方面，EA设置了止损以控制单笔风险，但缺乏动态仓位调整和多重风控层级的完善设计。整体策略逻辑清晰，但在震荡行情中可能产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following, identifying the dominant market trend direction through technical indicators and entering trades when the trend is expected to continue. Entry conditions are typically based on fast and slow moving average crossovers, or price breaking above/below key moving averages to signal trend initiation. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels, along with potential trend reversal signals for position closure. Position sizing employs either fixed lot sizes or an account balance-proportional method. Money management incorporates stop losses to control per-trade risk, but lacks dynamic position adjustment and comprehensive multi-layer risk control. The overall strategy logic is clear, but may generate frequent false signals during ranging markets leading to consecutive losses.

parameters.name: LotSize
parameters.description_en: Fixed lot size, used when MMRec is disabled

pros: 策略逻辑简洁明了，易于理解和维护
针对EUR/USD一小时周期优化，符合该货币对的趋势特性
设置了止损止盈，具备基本的风险控制能力
使用均线交叉等经典技术分析方法，可靠性经过长期验证
固定时间框架交易，避免了过度交易的风险
pros_en: Clear and simple strategy logic that is easy to understand and maintain
Optimized for EUR/USD on the 1-hour timeframe, aligning with the pair's trending characteristics
Includes stop loss and take profit for basic risk control capability
Uses classic technical analysis methods like MA crossover with long-verified reliability
Fixed timeframe trading avoids the risk of overtrading
cons: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号和连续亏损
缺乏动态仓位管理机制，无法根据市场波动率调整仓位大小
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
缺少点差过滤器，在点差扩大时仍可能入场导致滑点损失
止损止盈为固定点数，未考虑ATR等动态波动率指标来适配市场节奏
cons_en: Trend following strategy tends to generate frequent false signals and consecutive losses during ranging markets
Lacks dynamic position sizing mechanism, unable to adjust lot size based on market volatility
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions on the same candle
Missing spread filter, may enter trades during spread widening causing slippage losses
Fixed stop loss and take profit in pips without ATR-based dynamic adjustment to match market rhythm
improvements: 增加ADX或波动率过滤器，在震荡行情中减少交易频率或暂停交易
使用ATR动态止损止盈替代固定点数，使风险管理适配当前市场波动率
添加新K线检查和时间过滤功能，避免重复开仓和非活跃时段交易
improvements_en: Add ADX or volatility filter to reduce trade frequency or pause trading during ranging markets
Replace fixed pip-based SL/TP with ATR-based dynamic levels to adapt risk management to current market volatility
Implement new bar check and time session filters to prevent duplicate entries and trading during inactive hours

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓导致过度持仓
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率变化，在高波动时段止损可能过小
没有点差过滤器，新闻事件或低流动性时段点差扩大时可能造成额外损失
risk_points_en: Missing new bar check may cause duplicate position openings on the same candle leading to overexposure
Fixed stop loss and take profit do not account for volatility changes, SL may be too tight during high volatility periods
No spread filter can cause additional losses when spreads widen during news events or low liquidity sessions

The EA includes basic risk management with stop loss and take profit levels.
